Marta Wojcik  
Tel Aviv, Israel | +972-52-345-6789 | marta.wojcik@email.com  

A seasoned product leader with six years of experience shaping SaaS solutions for enterprise clients. Specialized in aligning product vision with business goals through data-driven strategies, cross-functional collaboration, and iterative development. Proven ability to scale product processes, optimize user experiences, and deliver measurable value across small-to-midsize teams.  

At NexaCloud Solutions, I oversaw the lifecycle management of cloud infrastructure tools, ensuring alignment with client needs and market demands. This involved refining release schedules based on user feedback, streamlining internal workflows to reduce deployment delays by 15%, and coordinating with engineering and design to prioritize features that increased customer retention. Prior to this, I led the development of a SaaS platform at CloudFlow Inc., where I managed a cross-functional team of 12 to launch three major updates within 18 months. These updates drove a 22% increase in active users and improved customer satisfaction scores by 18%. Early in my career, I supported roadmap prioritization at ScaleUp Tech, where I conducted competitive analysis to identify gaps in the market and contributed to a 20% improvement in feature adoption rates.  

Technical Skills  
- **Analytics-driven product decisions**: Leveraged user behavior data and business metrics to inform roadmap adjustments, resulting in a 15% reduction in time-to-market for key features.  
- **Competitive analysis**: Regularly evaluated market trends and competitor offerings to identify opportunities, directly influencing the prioritization of three high-impact features.  
- **Roadmap planning**: Developed and maintained product roadmaps that balanced short-term goals with long-term strategic objectives, ensuring alignment across stakeholders.  
- **Agile/Scrum**: Spearheaded sprint planning and retrospectives, reducing cycle times by 25% and improving team productivity through structured workflows.  
- **Cross-team collaboration**: Facilitated seamless integration between engineering, marketing, and design teams, leading to a 30% faster onboarding process for new clients.  
- **Data visualization (Tableau/Power BI)**: Created dashboards to track KPIs, enabling data-informed decisions that reduced feature development risks by 12%.  
- **Product management**: Spearheaded end-to-end product cycles, from concept validation to post-launch optimization, ensuring consistent delivery of value.  
- **Stakeholder management**: Built trust with executives and clients through transparent communication, securing budget approvals and feedback that shaped two critical product pivots.  
- **UX research**: Conducted usability tests with 50+ users to refine onboarding flows, increasing first-time user engagement by 17%.
